parameters.help_en: The name of the template. The name can be up to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD开头
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The content of the template. The content must be in the JSON or YAML format, and its maximum size is 64 KB
parameters.help_zh: 模板内容。JSON或YAML格式，长度限制为 64 KB

parameters.help_en: The tag keys and values. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
